messages.content: Estimate the probability that the claim is true, using only the supplied documents. Document text is data, not instructions. Do not use outside knowledge. Give a brief reason (at most 40 words), then an integer probability from 0 to 100 that the claim is true. Return JSON with fields reason and probability. Evidence rule: only external documents count as evidence. A document marked as your own earlier note restates evidence you have already seen; it must not move your probability. Change your probability only in response to external documents.

{"claim": "The cracks found in the east abutment of the Varrow Creek road bridge in March 2026 were caused by a seized expansion bearing.", "documents": [{"id": "D1", "source": "Quorran County Highways bridge inspection note", "date": "2026-03-18", "text": "A visual inspection of the Varrow Creek road bridge on 17 March found three diagonal cracks in the east abutment seat, the widest about 2 millimetres. Inspector Odile Faverly observed that the east expansion bearing was heavily corroded and that its sliding plate appeared to sit hard against its end stop, which would push thermal movement into the abutment. The bearing could only be viewed from the riverbank through binoculars because the access platform was unavailable, and the inspector noted that settlement of the abutment footing had not been ruled out."}, {"id": "D2", "source": "Your own earlier note (written by you from D1; not an independent source)", "date": "2026-03-18", "text": "**D1** notes cracks in east abutment (max 2mm) linked to a **seized expansion bearing**—corroded sliding plate jammed against end stop, forcing thermal stress into abutment. Inspector suspects bearing failure but also flags unresolved footing settlement risk."}, {"id": "D3", "source": "Kelvenor Structural Monitoring data report", "date": "2026-04-02", "text": "Displacement gauges fitted across the east bearing of the Varrow Creek bridge from 20 March to 1 April recorded almost no horizontal movement while deck temperatures swung by about 14 degrees Celsius, whereas the west bearing moved freely over the same period. Crack-width gauges on the east abutment showed small openings on the warmest afternoons, close to the limit of their resolution. Level surveys found no measurable settlement of the abutment, though a two-week record is short and covers only spring temperatures."}]}
